analysis.purpose: CmdCtx is a command context interface used by CLI handlers to receive optional overrides, currently allowing a caller to specify an alternative current working directory via cwdOverride.
responsibilities: Carry optional per-command configuration into CLI handler functions
invariants: cwdOverride is optional and typed as string when present
risks: Spec-only; consumers may interpret cwdOverride differently (absolute vs relative path, existence checks)
whatToDistrust: coverage.readiness is 'unimplemented' and only one property is shown; full contract and all consumers are not in the seed

nodes.name: Command context
nodes.summary: Optional configuration object passed to CLI command handlers

nodes.name: cwdOverride
nodes.summary: Optional string override for the current working directory

edges.rationale: The interface defines the command context concept
cwdOverride is the sole declared property of CmdCtx
